scenario_name: Original Manufacturer Barcode Uncovered — Etekcity Kitchen Scale

vlm_evidence.warning_text_ocr: WARNING: To avoid danger of suffocation, keep this plastic bag away from babies and children. Do not use this bag in cribs, beds, carriages or playpens. This bag is not a toy.

polybag_present.reason: Transparent polybag is present enclosing the product box.

polybag_sealed.reason: Top of the polybag edges appear loose/open. Cannot confirm heat-seal from this angle.

fnsku_placement.reason: CRITICAL: No FNSKU label found anywhere on the polybag. The product has not been labelled with an FNSKU at all. fnsku_bbox: null.

fnsku_surface.reason: No FNSKU label present — surface classification is irrelevant, check fails by absence.

suffocation_warning.reason: Full extended suffocation warning clearly printed at the top of the polybag.

suffocation_legibility.reason: Warning text is sharp, bold, high-contrast, and fully legible.

manufacturer_barcode.reason: CRITICAL: Original Etekcity UPC-A barcode '8 10040 94307 1' is completely visible and scannable through the transparent polybag on the bottom-right of the product box. No FNSKU label has been placed over it.

annotations.label: ✅ Suffocation Warning — PASS
annotations.note: OCR: 'WARNING: To avoid danger of suffocation, keep this plastic bag away from babies and children. Do not use this bag in cribs, beds, carriages or playpens. This bag is not a toy.' — fully legible

annotations.label: ❌ EXPOSED UPC '8 10040 94307 1' — FAIL
annotations.note: Etekcity manufacturer UPC-A barcode fully visible and scannable through clear polybag. Must be covered by FNSKU label.

annotations.label: Etekcity Kitchen Scale EK6015 box
annotations.note: Product box fully visible through clear polybag. Brand, model, and all spec text readable.

quality_flags.notes: Excellent image quality and lighting. Best training image for the 'original_barcode_visible: true' class. The barcode is large, clear, and unambiguous. Also provides a strong negative training example for FNSKU absence (fnsku_bbox: null).

prd_rules_triggered: PRD §5.2 — An FNSKU label must be applied to cover all original manufacturer barcodes before the unit can be inbounded.
PRD §5.1 — All units must have a valid FNSKU label affixed to the polybag.
training_notes.vrd_model_learning_value: CRITICAL — This is the highest-value FAIL image in the dataset. It teaches the model three things simultaneously: (1) detect exposed manufacturer barcodes through clear polybag, (2) detect complete FNSKU absence (fnsku_bbox: null), (3) still correctly read the compliant warning. The VLM must learn that a good warning does not compensate for uncovered original barcodes.
